paragraphs: I'm a **Full-Stack Engineer** with **{{years}}+ years of experience**. Today I build healthcare and care-sector platforms with **React, Next.js, Django, Node.js and PostgreSQL**, owning features from requirements to production deployment.

At **Intergy Consulting** (Australia, remote) I maintain and extend a live support-worker allocation platform used by **50+ organizations, 300+ clinicians and 2,000+ users**. I took ownership of the inherited codebase after a one-month handover, have independently resolved **150+ production issues**, and work directly with Australian stakeholders every day.

I removed the platform's dependency on **Salesforce** by rebuilding its core service-validation logic in Django and PostgreSQL, and led the scripted migration of **~14,000 production records** through a dry-run comparison script and 5+ validation stages, with **zero data loss**.

Before that, at **Nanosoft Engineers**, I shipped **4+ offline-first React Native apps** for **2,000+ field technicians** and raised sync success in low-connectivity areas from **~30% to ~80%**. My **Master of Social Work (Medical & Psychiatry)** gives me real understanding of the clinicians and clients who use healthcare software, and I've mentored 2 junior developers through regular code reviews.

achievements.text: Resolved 150+ production issues on an inherited live platform
Migrated ~14,000 production records off Salesforce with zero data loss
Cut a long-loading service-creation workflow to seconds by optimizing PostgreSQL queries and API logic
Raised offline sync success in low-connectivity areas from ~30% to ~80%
Led 15+ Android and iOS store releases; cut image payloads 60% and UI latency 30%
